Name: Lauterbach support for CVA6 (instructions how to use Lauterbach on CVA6)
Description: Instructions on using Lauterbach on a multicore System-on-Chip (SoC) platform—Culsans—featuring two CVA6 RISC-V cores. This SoC is deployed on a Genesys2 development board, and a key focus of our effort has been enabling efficient debugging capabilities with Lauterbach's TRACE32, an industry-standard debugging suite.
Comment: ISOLDE WI ID 4.1.11. Public domain (CC0) for the Vivado/Lauterbach debugger configuration code contained therein.
